text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, while we're hard at work<n>training for the
upcoming NHK Mile<n>Cup...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Do you two have a<n>moment?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Howdy, Tazuna!
choice_data_list: What can we do for you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the short notice, Taiki<n>Shuttle, but
you've been requested<n>for an interview.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, an interview?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I imagine this reporter sees great<n>potential in you,
considering your<n>current track record. They're very
eager to feature you in a segment!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's amazing! It'd be a real honor!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is moving into the<n>limelight—proof that
her talents are<n>genuine.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's taken her first step<n>to becoming
the next Umamusume of<n>the Year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll let them know.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Could we take a few photos of you in<n>action next?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay, sure thing! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! The vigor you display<n>toward your craft
is comparable to the<n>best of the best.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Etsuko Otonashi, a reporter for<n>Twinkle Monthly,
has taken notice of<n>Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she has an exceptionally<n>good eye for
spotting budding talent<n>in the racing scene.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! Did ya get some good shots?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Each of these photos perfectly<n>captures your
strength, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
The power in your leaps, the elegance<n>in your
motion, the force behind your<n>every step... I'll be
following your<n>future exploits with bated breath.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Best believe I'll be runnin' my heart<n>out! 'Cause
I'm gonna be the next<n>Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The reporter's eyes widen upon<n>hearing Taiki's
words.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Oh... But your aptitude is for<n>short-distance races, is
it not?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sure is. Why do ya ask?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Er, well... Are you not aware?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
There hasn't ever been a single<n>sprinter selected
as Umamusume of<n>the Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid so. Races like the Arima<n>Kinen, Tenno
Sho, and the Japan Cup<n>garner far more attention
from the<n>public.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Restricting your scope to only<n>short-distance races
could pose a<n>problem...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her concerns mirror my own<n>following Taiki
Shuttle's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But knowing Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ya don't say! Veeery interesting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I don't reckon that'll be a<n>problem!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's not like there's any rule sayin' Ican't be chosen. So no problem,right?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Well, certainly. While there's no<n>precedent, it's
technically not<n>impossible...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then that settles it! I'm not changin'<n>my plan.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: If it hasn't been done, I'll be the first!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The first sprinter to be crowned<n>Umamusume of the
Year! Now, don't<n>that sound nice?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's enthusiasm is truly a<n>special
case—the lack of a precedent<n>is but a trivial matter
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Her words renew my conviction.
choice_data_list: We're in for a challenge, but let's give it our best!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's what?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
The thorny path ahead has never<n>been
conquered—yet the two of you<n>press on,
abandoning the concept of<n>fear itself!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... How inspirational to witness a<n>trainer willing
to endure any obstacle<n>for the sake of their trainee,
be it<n>spines prickling your skin or hot<n>sauce stinging
your wounds!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to follow you two on your<n>journey! I'll
keep record of your<n>every step!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! ♪ Make sure to keep your<n>eyes peeled!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Cause I've got a mighty fantastic<n>dream to show
ya...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And it's sure to make ya happy!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yes, I'm looking forward to it!
